title: Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#700, 2026-10-26), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, in a Steam library on an external drive (its own, not the Mac Steam's): does not launch in DXMT, DXVK or D3DMetal. The DXMT and DXVK logs show Fahrenheit.exe failing to load its own DLLs (Qt5, SDL2, libgcc_s_dw2-1, libstdc++-6), which were not beside it. The reporter then found them in a Fahrenheit.exe.local folder next to the exe, Windows' DLL redirection, which Wine's loader does not look in; with the DLLs linked next to the exe the game reached gameplay, needing Emulate display mode changes to keep its resolution and a DirectX 9 warning dismissed. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Plays for the one report once its DLLs are reachable. The game keeps its DLLs (Qt5, SDL2, the MinGW runtime, steam_api) in a Fahrenheit.exe.local folder beside the exe, which Windows' loader searches first (DLL redirection) and Wine's does not, so the game stopped before opening a window in every graphics mode. Linking those DLLs next to Fahrenheit.exe got the reporter in game; the resolution then needs Emulate display mode changes and is not always stable. Steam's Mac version is 32-bit and no longer runs on macOS, so Highball installs the Windows one. Nothing was measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: The game stops before opening a window in every graphics mode, its own DLLs not found
knownIssues.cause: the DLLs sit in Fahrenheit.exe.local, Windows' DLL redirection folder, which Wine's loader does not search (also missing upstream, checked 2026-10-26)
knownIssues.fix: by hand, link each DLL from Fahrenheit.exe.local next to Fahrenheit.exe (for x in Fahrenheit.exe.local/*.dll; do ln -s "$x" .; done in the game folder). Support for the folder in Highball's engines is planned

knownIssues.symptom: The first menu click switches the game to 1024x768 and then it fails with 'A DirectX 9.0c or higher compliant video card is needed' or 'D3D ERROR! Fail to create texture surface' (an M1, DXVK's Direct3D 9, highball-db#700)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed: opening a menu makes the game rebuild its Direct3D 9 device for its own fullscreen mode, and the device or its textures fail to create. In a window instead, the mouse sticks to the screen's right edge
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. Emulate display mode changes got the reporter in once, not reliably

knownIssues.symptom: A DirectX 9 warning dialog at start
knownIssues.fix: dismiss it, the game goes on
